description: A man in an ornate fur-trimmed brown and gold robe and fur hat leans forward with an open hand toward a seated monk in a yellow hat and red robe. The monk raises one hand and sits on a carved wooden throne. The setting is a round felt tent with lattice walls, a lit candle, and a brazier fire in the foreground. A doorway opens onto a moonlit lake, and two attendants stand in shadow at left.
